spend.title: Spend
spend.description: Review cumulative usage and provider-reported costs.
spend.allTime: All time · independent of trend range
spend.rangeHelp: 7 / 30 days affects the daily trend and details only, not cumulative metrics.
spend.empty: No cost records in this range
spend.chartAlt: Daily cost in CNY over {{n}} days. Exact values are in the table below.
spend.source: Actual costs come from provider call records. CNY and credits are counted separately; credits are not converted into money. Missing cost records do not confirm a free call.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage accounts, permissions and credits. Access is verified by the server.
users.amountError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
users.once: This temporary password is shown only once. Save it now and share it securely with the account owner.
users.copyFailed: Automatic copy failed. Select the password and copy it manually.

admin.true: This account will be able to manage all users, permissions and credits.
admin.false: This account will lose admin access. Created content is kept.

active.false: This account will lose access to sign-in and protected features. Existing content is kept.
active.true: This account will regain access to sign-in and protected features.

beta.true: Allow OpenAI image generation. Normal credit charges apply.
beta.false: Prevent new OpenAI image jobs. Existing works are kept.
